arguments.title: Archive — March 2, 2023 Board Call: Retention Data Follow-up
arguments.body:
## Agreed follow-up
Retention was a Q2 deliverable: produce a sharper month-12 retention cut, broken out cohort by cohort, and a version with the unusually large early customer removed. The current blended view was not sufficient; the April deck's retention section was waiting on better data, not a wording change.

## Owner
Devon was to obtain the raw cuts directly from the warehouse rather than use another CSV export or hand-shaped sheet.
